item.title: Youth Radio: Smart Talk Episode 7
item.description: Welcome to the seventh episode of Smart Talk on Youth Radio Raw. Make sure you tune in every week on Fridays from 6:15 to 7:35 pm! On this show, you’ll hear the recent news, personal experiences and a diverse selection of music. For photos of the show, go to Youth Radio’s Flickr page. Check out live...

item.title: Adult ISH: Love ISH
item.description: Actor Percelle Ascott (Netflix’s The Innocents) dishes out a South London slang lesson and calls out co-host Nyge’s fake British friends. Comedian Joel Kim Booster (Comedy Central, Conan) spills the secrets to his 17 dating app traps. Then co-hosts Merk and Nyge chit chat on whether ghosting is ever justified…especially if Merk’s toe jam is involved.

item.title: Adult ISH: Her ISH
item.description: Muslim American Olympian Ibtihaj Muhammad yacks evil smoked salmon and wins an Olympic medal. Young actress Sydney Sweeney (Eden from The Handmaid’s Tale) gives sound advice to her dead character. Then co-host Merk kicks Nyge off the show and brings on YR Media correspondent Charlie Stuip to chat about vajayjays and pap shmears!

item.title: Adult ISH: Life ISH
item.description: OWN’s Love Is ___ actor Will Catlett spills the deets on how he fell in love in one night like his character Yasir and what dating was like back in the day (quick answer: more class and less @ss.) Writer and dancer Marlee Grace shares the power of two imaginary people in her head — Gloria and Roger. Then Adult ISH co-hosts Merk and Nyge chop it up on...

item.title: Adult ISH: Pro ISH
item.description: Stockton Mayor Michael Tubbs talks Tupac and his MLK-inspired basic income program. Comedian Taylor Tomlinson tells church-approved Titanic jokes and shuts down grandma at the dinner table. Indie-rock star Snail Mail recants her hate for Crunchwrap Supremes. Also, co-host Merk does not do acid. Just air.

item.title: Adult ISH: Race ISH
item.description: Actor Marcus Scribner, aka Junior from Black-ish, dances with questions about interracial dating and HBCUs. Comedian Ronny Chieng, aka the senior correspondent on The Daily Show and fly a-hole cousin in Crazy Rich Asians, lovingly talks sh*t about sh*t talking Asians. item.title: Adult ISH: Nerd ISH
item.description: Rick and Morty composer Ryan Elder spills the backstories behind fan favorites like “Get Schwifty” and “African Dream Pop.” DIY-obsessed YouTuber Lauren Riihimaki (LaurDIY) did not make her mason jar chandelier (gasp!). Bumblebee Actor Jorge Lendeborg Jr. is Mr. Miyagi and a DC fan (#sorrynotsorry, Marvel).

item.title: Adult ISH: Self ISH
item.description: Demetrius Harmon (fka MeechOnMars on Vine) gets in his feels about how his mom saved his life and why communities of color struggle to talk about depression. item.description: Harvard Law’s first deaf-blind graduate Haben Girma gets chocolate cake and offers to teach YR Media’s Merk and Nyge how to salsa and surf in Costa Rica. item.title: College Admissions: This Time, It’s Personal
item.description: EpisodesSubscribeHoller/Follow It’s that time of year again: college decisions.
